newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania's Mazheikiu to be privatised in tender.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania's Mazheikiu to be privatised in tender.

text.p: The Lithuanian government said on Wednesday that the cabinet has approved a decision to include the Mazheikiu Nafta oil refinery in a list of companies to be privatised in international tenders in 1997-1998.
"The cabinet approved a decision that Mazheikiu Nafta should be included on the list of key enterprises to be privatised in an international tender in 1997-1998," the government's press office said.
The government earlier this year annouced its intention to privatise 13 key companies in the energy, telecommunications and transport sectors.
Mazheikiu Nafta was also included on the list but only as a part of the planned oil concern Lietuvos Nafta.
The government had planned to merge Mazheikiu, the Butinges oil terminal, Birzhu pipeline and distribution and sales company Lietuvos Kuras into a national oil company and sell it.
One official said the move to sell Mazheikiu separately might mean the government had dropped plans to create a single national oil company.
